items.problem: All three scored feature areas were unavailable because the candidate crashed during native XAML startup while four legacy deferral directives remained untouched.
items.evidence: migration-score.json: 3/3 features fail; session-log.txt turns 36 and 46: repeated 0xc000027b in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll; turn 38 grep: four x:DeferLoadStrategy occurrences.
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, scripts, and inventory for x:DeferLoadStrategy and x:Load; no migration rule existed.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap treated the superseded directive as migrate-as-is and the validator did not flag it, so the agent never applied the equivalent modern XAML form.
items.proposed_fix: Mechanically rewrite x:DeferLoadStrategy="Lazy" to x:Load="False", add a focused pattern section, and fail validation on residue.
items.generalizes: Older UWP applications commonly use the legacy lazy-loading directive in pages and control templates.

items.problem: The documented build command does not exist in the installed winapp CLI.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 8: winapp build exited 1 with ''build' was not matched'.
items.skill_search: Searched skill markdown for winapp build and dotnet build; SKILL.md prescribed winapp build in Step 3 and after validation.
items.root_cause: Build and launch responsibilities were conflated even though the validator already uses native dotnet build.
items.proposed_fix: Use dotnet build <project> -p:Platform=x64 consistently and reserve winapp for packaged launch.
items.generalizes: Every migration must compile, and the same installed CLI surface is shared across scenarios.

items.problem: A no-deferred-files migration always produced a validator consistency warning.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 36 and 46: '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows'.
items.skill_search: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 emitted '| (none) |'; Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 searched for 'No items deferred'.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Producer sentinel `(none)` did not match validator sentinel `No items deferred`.
items.root_cause: The two migration scripts used different representations for the same empty state.
items.proposed_fix: Make the bootstrap emit the validator's canonical No items deferred sentinel.
items.generalizes: Any migration with zero deferred files hits this producer/consumer mismatch.

items.problem: The bootstrap did not identify XAML-referenced assets stored in a sibling shared-content tree.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 10-22: rainier.jpg and valley.jpg were referenced by copied XAML but absent until the agent searched SharedContent and copied them.
items.skill_search: Searched the migration skill for SharedContent, linked assets, and unresolved ms-appx references; no guidance or check existed.
items.root_cause: Source copying is limited to the selected UWP project directory and does not inventory unresolved content URIs.
items.proposed_fix: Add an unresolved ms-appx asset inventory that reports missing paths and prompts resolution from linked/shared source locations.
items.generalizes: UWP SDK samples and multi-project apps frequently link media and resources from shared sibling directories.
